landing_description:
A full-stack developer who pairs deep engineering craft with an AI-assisted workflow — production-grade code delivered on startup timelines, without cutting the corners that cause rewrites later.

My approach goes beyond just writing code; I analyze business needs. I know how to create user-friendly interfaces and robust backends.

If you are looking for a developer who understands your goals—rather than just ticking boxes on a spec sheet—get in touch, and we can discuss the details of your project.
landing_aboutMe_bio: I'm Samir, a full-stack engineer with 5+ years turning product ideas into shipped software — web, mobile, and everything behind the scenes. These days that includes using AI tools throughout my workflow to move faster without skipping the fundamentals: solid architecture, clean code, and interfaces people actually enjoy using.
landing_event2019_tooltip: This year I finished playing professional football in the second team of Zenit
landing_event2020_tooltip: The following year I transferred to the St. Petersburg Polytechnic University
landing_event2021_tooltip: After my first year, I found my first job as a Frontend developer.
landing_event2022_tooltip: Joined the startup Inream, where I built AI-powered learning exercises for people studying foreign languages.
landing_event2025_tooltip: Built the Mentalix platform from scratch — a full-cycle corporate coaching platform now live in production.
landing_project_desc_inream: Language learning exercises powered by AI 2.0 for 40+ languages
landing_project_desc_duo: Language learning exercises powered by AI for 30+ languages
landing_project_desc_eatly: A recipes blog built as a practice project for T1 Holding.
landing_project_desc_mentalix: Full-cycle B2B coaching platform — solo-built, real auth & integrations, live in production for 11+ months.
landing_process_step1_desc: We talk through your goals, constraints, and what "done" actually looks like — no generic spec, no guesswork.
landing_process_step2_desc: I write and architect every line myself, using AI tools to move faster through the repetitive parts — so more of my time goes into the decisions that actually matter.
landing_process_step3_desc: You get working software early and often, not one big reveal at the end. Fewer surprises, faster feedback.
landing_process_step4_desc: Launched doesn't mean done. I stick around for fixes, iteration, and whatever comes next.
landing_footer_subcopy: Tell me about your project — I usually reply within a day.
